<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This strategy successfully rootskips 75-80% of the time if executed properly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A successful rootskip is done by getting Solak's HP down to ~1510K or lower at </nowiki><strong><nowiki>~45s</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you don't meet this threshold it's advised to ignore the rootskip attempt entirely.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
